The .10 choice of per-token alternatives is an implementation design, not authority to exempt these exact quoted mentions. A lexer/automaton is NOT required for closure.
Location: packages/core/src/discovery/signals.ts:161-172, especially :163 and :169-172. An apostrophe between word characters always remains inside the token; available alternatives only remove all apostrophes or a terminal possessive 's. Consequently an external opening quote joins the preceding word to the name's first token, or an external closing quote joins the last token to the following word. Neither alternative recovers the indexed token. Matching at :228-235 then emits no reason.
